snippet.title: Loot Bound Gameplay Trailer - 2025 Convergence Games Showcase
snippet.description:
Lootbound invites players into a pixel-art roguelite world where tactical choices and careful resource management are critical. Assemble a party, haul the treasure from the depths, and fight your way out through strategic turn-based combat. This new gameplay trailer was revealed in the 2025 Convergence Games Showcase.

Wishlist the game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3091140
